factual_errors: Madsen 2002 was published in NEJM 347(12), not issue 19.
The study did not use a pre-MMR historic control group; it compared vaccinated and unvaccinated children born after MMR introduction.
It presents Madsen 2002 as the strongest evidence while omitting the larger Hviid 2019 Danish cohort.
summary: The response helps but recommends the wrong Danish cohort, includes inaccurate citation/design details, and fails to ask the user to verify details.
